paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, navigation surface, inputs, light cards, and high-contrast text on dark surfaces

ink.$description: Ink — Display text, headings, filled public buttons, dark rules, and inline control outlines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body copy and dense explanatory text

steel.$description: Steel — Muted metadata and low-emphasis supporting copy

rule-gray.$description: Rule Gray — Hairline dividers, grid rules, and low-emphasis structural borders

edge-gray.$description: Edge Gray — Slightly stronger container and content-section borders

ice-panel.$description: Ice Panel — Contained story cards, problem/solution panels, and cool product-demonstration surfaces

forest-ledger.$description: Forest Ledger — Footer and full-width closing surfaces

plum-ledger.$description: Plum Ledger — Dark editorial/product cards and contrasting feature blocks

network-green.$description: Network Green — Logo mark, payment-rail connector lines, and small solution markers — a restrained institutional green that makes the diagrams feel like live infrastructure

mint-subscription.$description: Mint Subscription — Newsletter subscribe fill and bordered mint controls — the lone pale color action within the dark footer

ledger-brown.$description: Ledger Brown — Monospace problem labels and compact technical annotations

mt-neue-display.$description: Hero and major section headings. The 450 weight keeps 71px headlines broad and quiet rather than bold; it makes financial infrastructure feel measured instead of promotional.

mt-neue-text.$description: Product narrative headings and feature titles. Use the text cut for tighter, more practical statements below display-scale hierarchy.

mt-sans.$description: Navigation, body copy, links, inputs, buttons, footer lists, and card UI. Use 330 for subdued footer links, 360 for body paragraphs, 500 for navigation, and 600 for controls.

mt-mono.$description: Technical eyebrow labels and diagram annotations; the monospace treatment turns short labels into ledger metadata rather than conventional marketing eyebrows.
